title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
description_en: arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_\theta(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_\theta$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. title: Hub
description_en: Run 100 Claude Code or Codex sessions like 5. Open-source dispatcher for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Write a goal in your browser or Telegram, a coordinator hands it to agents, and only the decisions come back. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0, on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription. One-line install. Experimental: agents run without permission prompts.

title: Wizstar R1
description_en: Seedance 2.0-level product videos at a lower cost. Wizstar R1 is an in-house AI video model built for affordable, everyday creation. Combine up to nine reference images and videos to generate 5–15-second videos with native audio, guided by your products, characters, scenes, and styles. R1 excels at animation and 3D content and matches Seedance 2.0's usable-output rate for product videos in internal tests. Eligible members enjoy unlimited, credit-free generation, giving creators more freedom to experiment and refine their ideas.

title: QA.tech MCP
description_en: Verify every change from your IDE with QA agents. QA.tech MCP gives Claude Code, Cursor or Codex an external QA agent to check their work. It runs E2E tests on what each change does to your product and finds the bugs and edge cases your coding agent missed, so they get fixed before the PR goes to review. Stay in your IDE: QA.tech explores your app, writes the tests and runs them. Your coding agent reads the results and fixes what broke. Works with any MCP client. New to QA.tech? One prompt maps your app and kicks off your first test.

title: ExtraOrbital
description_en: ✦ Open bar databases, storage buckets & AI keys for agents. Your app needs databases, storage, caching, AI keys, and more. That's dozens of accounts, API keys, invoices, and backups to manage. Agents can't stand it. They don't even have access. You feel like their credentials go-fetch puppet. ExtraOrbital reads yourenv.example file and creates all these ressources for you. It's a CLI, so your agents can use it. They don't even need an account. You gain back control, increase security and manage everything in a central dashboard. Bye bye,env hell !

title: Depost AI
description_en: The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand. Depost AI scores every LinkedIn post you've published against your own average, finds what's winning in your niche, then plans the month, writes in your voice, and designs the graphics. You approve every post, and it publishes through LinkedIn's official API. It also drafts replies to the conversations worth joining, so posts turn into leads—works in the app, or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

title: Bifura
description_en: See your website the way AI agents do. AI assistants now read websites for your buyers. Bifura fetches your page the way AI crawlers do, shows what they get and get wrong, and lets you test fixes in a sandbox before you ship. Free Agent readiness score in under a minute, no signup.

title: Contral
description_en: The AI coding agent that checks its work and teaches you. Contral is out of beta. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or Copilot CLI inside Contral, on your own account. Contral checks every turn against what you asked for and sends smaller models a specific correction, explains every change with a teaching card, and undoes a whole turn in one click. Plus Defense Mode, video explanations by Scrimba, and Learn mode in 5 languages. In VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and more, or the Contral IDE. Free to start.

title: Periscope
description_en: Turn any work into an API. Describe a task and get an endpoint for it. An agent does the work through the screen on its own cloud desktop, in any software, however old. Call it over REST, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. The Free plan needs no card.

title: Pax by Pydantic
description_en: A coding agent where even coding is a plugin. Pax is the official Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal. Every part is a plugin, it runs any model, and --agent runs your own Pydantic AI agent in it.

title: Pushary Calls
description_en: Miss your AI agent’s ping? Pushary calls you.. Your AI agent stops to ask before it does anything big. If you're at lunch, it sits there until you're back. Pushary sends the question to your phone. Miss it, and Pushary calls you. You hear what the agent wants and say yes, no, or what to do instead. Then it keeps working. Calls only ring in hours you pick. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and more.

title: Doodle
description_en: The stick figure on your taskbar that answers questions. Doodle is a little AI companion that lives on your Windows taskbar. Ask it anything with Ctrl+Shift+Space, or dictate into any app. When it can't do something, Doodle Evolution builds a bespoke plugin, shows you what it can reach, and waits for your OK.

title: Kagi Mail
description_en: Private email that puts people who need you first. Kagi Mail is a private email service designed to help you focus on what matters. Its intelligent inbox highlights people waiting for your reply, identifies emails that need action, and keeps newsletters and unwanted messages out of the way. Ask questions about your inbox, organize emails using natural-language rules, and use unlimited aliases and custom domains. No ads, no tracking, no profiling. Includes 50 GB storage and a built-in calendar, with open standards and no vendor lock-in.

title: Espresso 27
description_en: The web editor for people who love the Mac. The biggest Espresso ever. A new look for macOS 27, an AI that builds across your whole site without a line of it leaving your Mac, and an editor with far more under the hood.

title: snibl
description_en: Save highlighted text from any app, then ask AI about it. Stop losing the things you read. Highlight text in any app on Mac or Windows and Snibl saves it with its source and context, so you can find it later. Then just ask: Snibl AI answers your questions using your own saved snippets. Software you actually own

title: ChickyTutor
description_en: A language tutor that knows you better daily. Now on iOS. Hi Product Hunt! I’m Phanos, founder of ChickyTutor. We’re returning with our new iOS app for iPhone and iPad. Talk face to face with your AI language tutor, answer out loud, get gentle feedback when something needs fixing, and try again straight away. You can pick your language and level, follow guided Journey chapters in supported languages, and keep your practice synced across iPhone, iPad, Android, and the web. Try it at https://www.chickytutor.com/mobileapp

title: Monton
description_en: AI agents that do your agency's busywork. Monton is agency management software with AI agents built in. Agents watch budgets, chase overdue invoices, write client reports and remind people about missing hours, on your real hours, staffing, billing and CRM data. Pick one of 18 templates or describe it in a chat. Every email waits for your approval. AI is included in every paid plan: no credits, no per-seat pricing. Free up to 5 people.

title: Woomool
description_en: AI Canvas where thinking becomes tangible. Woomool is a AI canvas tastefully designed for ideation, knowledge management, and live collaboration. Clean, unobtrusive, and beautiful, it inspires you to focus and go deep into your thinking.

title: slay
description_en: AI composition guide camera app for iPhone. slay is an iPhone camera app that overlays 14 composition guides directly on your live camera view — Portrait 1, Portrait 2, Close Up, Side Chick, Travel Shot, One-Third, Two-Third, Vanishing Point, One-Point Vertex, Two-Point Vertex, Triangle 1, Triangle 2, Aerial Triangle, One-Point Aerial — each with the camera height, angle, zoom and distance to use, plus 38 built-in LUTs, so photos are framed and post-ready without editing.

title: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP
description_en: Your company's words, assembled into a book. Prosed AI is now for businesses. Your team has already published the ideas. Prosed AI assembles them into a non-fiction book inside your assistant. The Source Map and review packet help reviewers focus on the joins. Bring a body of work, not just an idea. AI-assisted bridges are marked for review. One book: $299, once. Free until the outline. $149 until Mon Nov 30

title: DeskFleet
description_en: Run coding agents together across your team’s machines. DeskFleet gives your team a shared session with the coding agents you already use. Run Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor where your code lives. A teammate can join from their laptop, review the diff, approve the next command, or take control of the remote desktop. Your tools and agent credentials stay on the machine doing the work.

title: Onset
description_en: AI reviews, titles and thumbnails for YouTube creators. Onset reads your own YouTube Analytics and reviews each upload 48 hours after it goes live, then drafts titles in your voice and thumbnails in your channel's style. Read-only: it never posts. We're letting creators in from the waitlist, a few at a time.

title: gpyou
description_en: The OpenRouter for compute for the cheapest GPU in stock. One CLI for GPU clouds worldwide. gpyou rents the cheapest GPU in stock, moves to the next offer when one is sold out, and bills per second from prepaid credit. Run containers, fine-tune, serve models or a coding model of your own.

title: Remora
description_en: The long-term memory layer for AI agents. Remora is continuous memory infrastructure for AI agents. Ingest conversations, deduplicate facts, and recall relevant context in under 15ms. Powered by PostgreSQL + pgvector with native Python & TypeScript SDKs. Stop re-inventing memory tables.

title: Flurra
description_en: Ask Claude or ChatGPT to edit your videos. Flurra is a video editor that Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants can use for you. Connect it once (sign in, no API key), then describe the edit: cut the dead air, add bold hook text, put your logo top-right, cut yourself onto a new background, or match the style of a video you love. Claude edits your Flurra project, you preview every change and keep only what you like, then it renders the 1080p cut. Flurra also writes scripts in your voice and plans your posts. iPhone and web.

title: Arbitrica
description_en: Agent that finds hidden prices & fights pricing algorithms. Arbitrica is an AI agent that detects the world’s lowest price for anything online, starting from hotels globally. The price we're shown is the result of which country we search from; what phone we use; what time we look at... Behind this are pricing algos designed to maximise revenue from every person. Arbitrica gives people an agent that fights back. It wakes up when you are about to pay, searches from 195 countries, finds the lowest price on Earth, and prepares everything checkout ready

title: Nookdeck
description_en: Turn your old phone into a Stream Deck for your computer. Nookdeck turns an old phone or tablet into a touch control panel for your Mac or Windows PC. A small app on the computer serves the panel to the phone's browser over Wi-Fi: no app to install on the phone, no account, no cloud. Old iPhones on iOS 12 work too. Buttons for shortcuts, apps, media and macros; live tiles for system stats, Now Playing and weather; Home Assistant controls; Claude and Codex usage; plugins and theme packs. Free and open source (MIT).

title: Watch Reader
description_en: Books and articles, read aloud on your Apple Watch. Add books, articles and web pages on your iPhone, then leave it at home. The AI voice runs on your Apple Watch itself, so it reads to you with no signal. Morning news, 25 voices, free classics. Free to download, with 30min free listening everyday forever.

title: Meboki
description_en: Offline grammar checker for any Mac app. Open source. Most grammar checkers send everything you type to someone else's server. Meboki checks your English with an open-source AI model running on your own Mac. Wavy underlines appear as you type in Mail, Slack, Notion, Gmail and most other apps; press Return to fix them all. Like Grammarly's grammar and spelling fixes, but offline: no account, no subscription, no telemetry. GPL-3.0 source. $39 once, 50% off each for 3+ licences; free hotkey mode after the 7-day trial. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.

title: Ground
description_en: Generate high quality synthetic data for testing or training. Ground turns a one-sentence description into consistent synthetic tables where every key, total and rate holds, or extends a dataset you already have. One sentence produced 72,365 rows with 0 orphan keys; asked for ~5% overdue, it delivered. Use it in the browser, via API, or from Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT through its MCP server. If you need human written level data at scale Ground has you covered.

title: Transept AI
description_en: Translate your book in your own voice and prove authorship . Since our first launch, Transept became a tool for writers translating their own books. New: you read the translation as a book, next to your original. Author mode reads your manuscript first and drafts the glossary, style guide and characters for you to approve. The Originality report records, word by word, what the AI wrote and what you changed. PDFs come back as the same pages. The Free plan translates your first page in full; paid plans from €9/$10 a month.

title: Upsolve Harness 2.0
description_en: A data agent that's 2x faster and learns every user. We rebuilt our agent harness from scratch for people who don't know the data. Twice as fast, self-correcting SQL, custom skills for your analyses, suggestions that improve it over time, and memory that personalises every user.

title: iwantmy.app
description_en: Describe a mobile app in chat and open it on your phone. Tell iwantmy.app what your app is for and who uses it. About a minute later it runs on a phone, with accounts, staff roles, bookings with places left, photos, maps and group chat built in. Ask for changes in chat; each one goes live when it is done, and a failed change leaves the app as it was. Open your app from its link or QR code in the phone's browser, or in our test app for iPhone and Android. Free plan: 1 app and 30 AI changes a month, no card.

title: Ploid
description_en: People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles. Ploid is a people search engine with a living index of over two billion people. Search by role, company, skills or location, get up to 150 results per request, and merge someone's professional, social and personal sites into one Superprofile. Agents can reason over posts, photos and talks, not just database fields. Available as API, CLI and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor.

title: Hello Transcribe 5
description_en: Private transcription with speaker labels, all on device. Hello Transcribe turns speech into text on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, entirely on device: no account, no uploads. Free: Apple SpeechAnalyzer and every whisper.cpp model. PRO: Speaker labels with NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet v3 and Whisper on Core AI, iCloud Sync & Audio save.

title: OpenChat
description_en: Open-source live chat in your own Cloudflare account. Customer chat for your website that runs in your own Cloudflare account, so conversations stay with you. A 2 KB widget in 11 languages, a team inbox on web, iPhone and Android with end-to-end encrypted notifications, a help centre, and an optional AI assistant that answers first and hands over to a person. Open source and self-hosted, with one-click deploy.

title: Hello Transcribe 5
description_en: Private transcription with speaker labels, all on device. Hello Transcribe turns speech into text on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, entirely on device: no account, no uploads. Free: Apple SpeechAnalyzer and every whisper.cpp model. PRO: Speaker labels with NVIDIA Nemotron, Parakeet v3 and Whisper on Core AI, iCloud Sync & Audio save.

title: Spark AI
description_en: AI-native permitting & diligence services for data centers. Will that data center actually come online? Spark offers AI-native services built on a permitting intelligence platform: agents research 20,000+ jurisdictions, and an expert reviews every deliverable. Used by NextEra, Prologis, Intersect (Google), and others with a combined 200 GW pipeline. Three services: Stakeholder Intelligence (who decides, how they voted), Permit Matrices (which permits, from whom, timelines), and Project Diligence (risks from regulation, utilities & power, competition).

title: MeetFolks
description_en: AI Notetaker for In-Person Meetings. MeetFolks turns in-person meetings into named transcripts, summaries, and action items. Everyone joins from their own phone or laptop, so each person is captured close up by their own mic. Each device recognises its owner's voice, so you know who said what without labelling speakers yourself or buying a dedicated recorder.

title: Antipode
description_en: Share your unused Claude Code limits without breaking ToS. Your Claude Code weekly limit resets whether you used it or not. With Antipode, your agent spends what's left on a public GitHub project whose owner asked for help and opens a pull request. When you run out, others' agents work on yours. Free, open source.

title: MusicProductionAI
description_en: Make music from a prompt or a hum, right in your browser. Music production software that runs in a browser tab. Describe a track or upload a hummed melody and get an instrumental of 15, 30 or 60 seconds. Record, arrange and mix it in the built-in DAW, then export a WAV. Split any song into stems, find its chords and key, or program a beat on the free drum machine. Your first 3 tracks are free with no sign-up. After that it is pay as you go: one-time credit packs from $9, credits never expire, no subscription.

title: Chunkify
description_en: Video Streaming API for Developers & AI Agents. Chunkify is a video streaming platform for developers and AI agents. Your videos stay in your own S3 or R2 bucket and stream through your CDN, so you always own your data. One API covers the full pipeline: uploads, per-title adaptive encoding, HLS streaming, thumbnails, captions and playback analytics.

title: AgentDE
description_en: Put all your coding agents in one native Mac window. AgentDE puts all your terminal agents (Claude Code, Codex, or any other CLI agent) in one native Mac window. Each tab's icon shows its agent's state: green is working, amber needs you, blue is done. ⌘-click any path an agent prints and the file opens above the chat, at that line. Workstreams keep a shared record of each task that survives compaction. Tabs keep running when you quit or update. Free, MIT licensed, and built to be vibe coded into your own.

title: WhipDesk
description_en: Control AI coding agents from your phone. WhipDesk puts your whole dev machine in your phone's browser, built for babysitting AI coding agents. Answer Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Cursor when they get stuck, review the diff, and test what they built. Get alerts when an agent needs you, save one-tap prompts, and schedule a "resume" for when your session limit resets at 2 AM. Open source on both ends, end-to-end encrypted, free.

title: Claude-Mem Cloud Sync
description_en: Switch devices. Keep your AI agents' memory.. Claude-Mem is the open-source memory engine for AI coding agents (119k+ GitHub stars). Cloud Sync carries what your agents learn (decisions, fixes, discoveries) to every computer you use. Save a decision on your desktop, recall it from your laptop. See synced work in any browser, recall it in ChatGPT via a private MCP connector, and keep your own model provider. 30 days free, no card.

title: Ottante
description_en: Checks the work your AI agents did, right on your Mac. Your AI says it's done, but is it right? When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini finish, Ottante compares the project with the model it came from and alerts you only about what's new. The check uses no AI. Stays on your Mac.

title: NEXUS
description_en: Map codebase locally and AI changes only what you approved. NEXUS is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that helps you understand a codebase before anything changes it. It indexes a folder locally and maps the architecture — modules, imports, dependency cycles, most-imported files — with no AI or account. Share a one-file report with no source code, benchmark local models on your own hardware, and let AI agents work in a separate Git worktree that changes your files only after you approve the plan, each command and the diff.

title: Spiderlook
description_en: Turn your rivals' ads, posts and site changes into insights. Spiderlook is an AI-powered competitive intelligence platform for marketing teams and agencies. It tracks your rivals' Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Meta and Google ads, and websites, bringing everything together in one place. Unlike tools that simply dump a feed of posts, Spiderlook highlights meaningful changes and turns them into actionable insights, each backed by the exact ad, post or page behind it. MCP included, so you can ask Claude or ChatGPT about your competitors.

title: Botric
description_en: Invisible in AI Search? Get your brand into AI answers. Track and improve your brand's visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and more. Monitor mentions, citations, and competitors, and create optimized content with Botric's content agents to increase your chances of being recommended by AI.

title: RunSEO
description_en: AI visibility on autopilot: run your SEO, AEO and GEO.. RunSEO runs your entire SEO and AEO lifecycle. From planning and research to publishing, indexing, tracking, analytics, AI search prompt tracking, and refreshes. You decide what goes live. Backed by a 7-figure SEO agency, without AI slop.

title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
description_en: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
